title: Introduce egress-holdoff mesh and staggered prefetch throttle to stabilize regional failovers
author: Maya Chen
body: Motivation: During a cross-region incident we observed aggressive prefetching and immediate egress retries amplifying downstream congestion and causing rapid circuit flips for tenant slowpaths. This PR introduces a lightweight egress-holdoff mesh plus a staggered prefetch throttle to reduce amplification during failovers and stabilize SLO enforcement. Summary of changes: 1) egress-holdoff mesh: introduces a short, topology-aware holdoff window after a region-level failover signal that prevents immediate egress to remote regions for a configurable cohort of low-priority requests; 2) staggered prefetch throttle: replaces the single global prefetch token bucket with per-tenant soft windows that ramp prefetch capacity in linear steps over a warmup period; 3) metrics and tracing: new telemetry around holdoff cohort sizes, per-tenant prefetch rate, and prefetch-warmup percentiles; 4) safety nets: increased backoff jitter on cross-region retries and a new circuit cooldown gate that prevents reopen until token-stability is observed for a minimum epoch. Checklist: - [x] Spec and design doc linked (Linear ENG-1987) - [x] Unit tests for throttle/warmup logic - [x] Integration test for holdoff mesh with simulated regional failover - [x] Load test showing 20-35% reduction in cross-region egress within first 30s of failover - [x] Telemetry dashboards added and alerts tuned (console dashboards) Commits: "initial egress-holdoff mesh implementation and config (sha a1b2c3)", "staggered prefetch token windows and warmup logic (sha d4e5f6)", "add telemetry and dashboards (sha f7g8h9)", "ci fixes and test flake mitigation (sha i1j2k3)" Files / areas touched: runtime/router/egress_holdoff.go, runtime/prefetch/prefetch_manager.go, runtime/prefetch/warmup_policy.go, runtime/circuit/cooldown_gate.go, telemetry/metrics_registry.go, integration/region_failover_test.go, docs/design/egress-holdoff.md Review notes: - Reviewer Sofia Alvarez: requested stronger invariants on holdoff cohort selection and fewer global side-effects; asked to make holdoff default opt-in via a feature flag for Dedicated customers. - Reviewer Ethan Park: asked for clearer fallthrough logic when holdoff cohort is saturated; suggested adding a telemetry tag for cohort eviction reason. - Author responses: feature-flag added (default off for private/dedicated); cohort eviction reason tag implemented; added more unit tests for edge cases. CI: initial CI run showed a flaky integration test timeout (integration/region_failover_test) which was fixed by extending test harness TTL; final CI status: pass. Performance: internal perf lab runs show 25% reduction in peak egress token allocation and a 1-3ms median improvement in tail latency for non-primed tenants during failover windows. Rollout plan: staged rollout via canary (10% of regions) -> 50% -> full; default off for Dedicated and Private until customer validation. Related work: linear ENG-1987, ENG-2042; follow-up planned to add per-model warmup tuning (ENG-2101). Merge: merged via squash on 2026-02-22 by maintainer Noah Singh after two approvals. Release notes: "stability: reduce cross-region amplification during failovers via egress holdoff mesh and staggered prefetch throttle; configurable feature flag; improved telemetry." Breaking change: false
